title: Sikky Nissan 350z and Infiniti G35 LHD LS Swap Power Steering Line Kit
description:
This power steering line is designed to mate your LS1 or LS2 power steering pump to your 350z power steering rack with OEM fitment.

Features:



Fits LS1 & LS2 Power steering reservoirs

Swiveling fitting for optimum fitment

Maximum durability to heat and racing conditions

Extreme high pressure line with max pressure of 10,000 PSI for no worries of breakage

Includes Low pressure power steering return line w/ clamps
